edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, making ownership caller-dependent.
transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner before allowing ownership change.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
_newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
Fallback executes for any msg.sender sending ETH.
Fallback immediately refunds msg.value to the caller via transfer.
Fallback queries token.allowance(msg.sender, this) to decide the path.
Zero allowance with existing deposit routes fallback execution to withdraw().
Non-zero allowance routes fallback execution to invest().
source bytes parameter flows into bytesToAddress1.
bytesToAddress1 executes inline assembly mload on attacker-controlled msg.data.
invest is publicly callable and keyed on msg.sender.
withdraw is publicly callable and keyed on msg.sender.
setRef records referers[msg.sender] and refIsSet[msg.sender].
msg.sender indexes refIsSet when registering referrals.
_referer parameter flows into invest and is passed to setRef.
invest forwards _referer into setRef.
Local _value is the allowance amount used as deposit in invest.
Allowance-derived amount is used by token.transferFrom in invest.
invest performs an external token.transferFrom call.
invest makes external token.transfer calls before/after state mutations, enabling reentrancy through the token contract.
withdraw performs external token.transfer calls after updating withdrawn but before completing all accounting.
withdrawn is credited before the external token transfer completes, allowing re-entrant re-withdrawal.
invest credits withdrawn then calls external token.transfer, leaving reentrancy window.
getInfo computes withdrawable amount directly from block.timestamp.
invest uses block.timestamp for dividend accrual and checkpoint update, making payout miner-influenced.
withdraw derives amountToWithdraw from block.timestamp, a timestamp-dependency issue.
block.timestamp is stored into lastTimeWithdraw as the new reference point.
lastTimeWithdraw[msg.sender] feeds the amountToWithdraw computation in invest.
deposit[msg.sender] feeds the amountToWithdraw computation in invest.
block.timestamp delta drives accrued dividends in invest.
lastTimeWithdraw[msg.sender] feeds the amountToWithdraw computation in withdraw.
deposit[msg.sender] feeds the amountToWithdraw computation in withdraw.
block.timestamp delta drives accrued dividends in withdraw.
Computed amountToWithdraw is passed to token.transfer; arithmetic relies on NewSafeMath library operations.
Accrued amountToWithdraw is transferred in invest using SafeMath-derived values.
refBonus[msg.sender] is read into local _bonus in invest.
refBonus[msg.sender] is read into local _bonus in withdraw.
Referral bonus is paid via external token.transfer after resetting refBonus, creating a reentrancy window.
Referral bonus is paid via external token.transfer in withdraw, creating a reentrancy window.
invest updates deposit[msg.sender] with the new investment amount.
invest updates withdrawn[msg.sender] with accrued amounts.
invest resets lastTimeWithdraw[msg.sender] to block.timestamp.
invest increments the deposits counter for new investors.
invest invokes refSystem for existing referred investors.
invest invokes setRef when a new referer is provided.
refSystem credits refBonus using add/div/mul arithmetic on the invested value.
setRef credits refBonus[msg.sender] via _value.div(50).
setRef writes referers[msg.sender] = referer.
setRef sets refIsSet[msg.sender] = true.
setRef calls refSystem to distribute multi-level bonuses.
_value flows into refSystem bonus arithmetic.
_referer flows into refSystem mapping lookups and credits.
_value flows into setRef bonus arithmetic.
referer flows into setRef referral registration.
_address parameter indexes deposit/withdrawn/refBonus in getInfo.
_address parameter indexes referral mappings in getRefInfo.
_address parameter indexes lastTimeWithdraw in getTime.
Fallback participates in the contract lifecycle initiated at construction.
